title: "about"

I have a noisy brain. I'm also forgetful. In an attempt to organize that noise, and to help me remember things, I've started this website to share things that I find interesting. 

Most writings will have a data science flavor, though I make no promises. This website is powered by coffee, so if you find any of this helpful and would like to support my work, consider [buying me a coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/echinos).
